comment: pager.c look_all(), look_traps() and look_engrs() put each line's symbol through encglyph() and putmixed(); wintty.c tty_putmixed() decodes it to the glyph's gs.showsyms[] byte and process_text_window() prints the stored line a byte at a time. Recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() ignores a byte below 32 or with its high bit set, so the symbol's cell stays blank. On the Rogue level with ROGUESYMBOLS control bytes for the hero, the dog and food; back on Dlvl 1 the primary symbols are printed.
